gen-luckiest-guy-fs-quicksand: Quicksand moves in smooth, tall-bowled lowercase, like little glass bulbs strung along a line. Quicksand's real gift is its friendliness, which lets Luckiest Guy stay as loud and poured-ink cheerful as it likes.
gen-gf-funnel-display-fs-merriweather-sa: Funnel Display draws spaghetti-thin strokes, all one width and full of swagger. Merriweather Sans below it has tall, sturdy lowercase that looks large already, so you can usually trim its size and lose nothing.
gen-irish-grover-fs-nunito: Nunito reads soft and contemporary, its big round bowls and terminals stopping well short of the stem. Irish Grover is the one with fun, organic wobble; Nunito simply keeps text friendly.
gen-gf-oxanium-fs-merriweather-sans: A high x-height makes Oxanium's lowercase look big, drawn in uninterrupted monoline strokes with curves ending in clear daylight. And Merriweather Sans, plain sans and sturdy, can take a slightly smaller size without losing any presence.
gen-gf-metamorphous-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Be Vietnam Pro reads like bent steel rod, its curve endings never crowding one another and its midline sitting high. And Metamorphous holds the top with generous sidebearings, so a long stretch of text stays crisp underneath it.
gen-fs-gambarino-fs-merriweather-sans: Merriweather Sans makes words look sturdy and large, with tall lowercase and an e that opens clearly to the right. Gambarino's heavy stems sit above it.
gen-fs-gambarino-fs-plein: Plein reads reliable and clean, with a clear channel leading into every round letter. Plein keeps a long passage moving smoothly beneath Gambarino, whose heavy stems and hairline whiskers do the dramatic work.
gen-fs-gambarino-fs-supreme: Supreme sets a thick, heavy-looking strip of text through the middle, with letters held open rather than curled shut. Gambarino does drama best; Supreme does crisp sans-serif clarity.
gen-fs-gambarino-manrope: Manrope has a bright open gap at every curved letter's mouth and a pen line holding one width throughout. Gambarino does the sharp work, thick strokes against hairlines, while Manrope stays friendly and clean.
gen-fs-gambarino-outfit: Outfit reads like cable bent into shapes, never swelling or thinning. Gambarino does carved ink-and-thread drama best, while Outfit simply keeps the sans-serif text clean and approachable.
